[1. PURPOSE]
Generate a SFW moe anime scene still, like a single frame from an after-school clubroom OVA.
Focus on a living panel-like moment, not a cover, poster, key visual, or promotional layout.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {주인공} sits slightly right of center on {자세 위치}, framed in a horizontal 16:9 anime scene composition.
- Background treatment: {동아리방 배경} fills the full frame with believable depth, warm after-school atmosphere, and no empty poster-like backdrop.
- Spacing, framing: medium-wide shot showing upper body, desk edge, window light, and surrounding clubroom details; leave natural breathing room around the character.
- Expression and anatomy: {표정} with {눈 묘사}, soft face proportions, natural hands, correct school-uniform fit, SFW presentation.
- Use {프레임 성격} as the key visual logic: a captured animated moment with cinematic continuity.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top / background plane — wide classroom-clubroom wall, noticeboard, shelves, sunlit window curtains, and subtle dust motes shaped by {창문 빛}.
2) Hero area — {주인공} wearing {복장}, sitting at {자세 위치}, torso turned gently toward camera, one hand resting near the desk edge, {표정} as the emotional hook.
3) Mid section — desk surface with {소품}, soft cast shadows, warm highlights on hair strands, sparkling pupils, and layered cel-shading around cheeks and uniform folds.
4) Bottom / foreground — blurred desk corner and small classroom objects create depth; no title text, no logo, no cover-style typography.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: N/A; this is a textless anime scene frame.
- Character style: {캐릭터 스타일}, large expressive eyes, shimmering pupils, delicate blush, clean facial silhouette, softly flowing hair strand groups.
- Color palette: {색상 팔레트}, with peach-gold sunset highlights, gentle amber rim light, creamy beige interiors, and muted schoolroom greens/browns.
- Shading: {셀셰이딩 강도}; crisp anime cel-shadow blocks mixed with soft gradient glow on skin and hair.
- Linework: thin dark-brown key lines, slightly varied pressure, clean OVA-style drawing fidelity.
- Scene rule: make it feel like an actual animated panel with background depth, not a flat poster or character sheet.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: {카메라 앵글}, {렌즈 느낌}, horizontal cinematic framing, shallow but readable depth of field.
- Lighting: {창문 빛}, warm golden hour light entering from camera-left window, soft bloom on hair edges and desk varnish.
- Color grade: nostalgic late-afternoon anime grade, warm highlights, mild teal shadows, gentle film-grain texture, polished digital cel animation finish.

[6. MOOD]
Cozy after-school moe slice-of-life with a gentle, sparkling, SFW OVA still-frame feeling.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: N/A — no Korean text should appear in the image.
- Must remain SFW: {안전 수위}; school uniform should be neat and non-revealing.
- Keep the image as a scene still / panel moment, not a cover, poster, thumbnail, character reference sheet, or promotional key art.
- Hands anatomically correct, natural wrist angles, five fingers when visible, consistent eye direction, no distorted pupils.
- Maintain large eyes, sparkling pupils, soft hair strands, warm sunset window light, detailed clubroom background, and cinematic 16:9 framing.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Real brand logos (Apple, Samsung, Naver, Kakao, etc)
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Sexualized minors or unsafe school-uniform depiction

- Wide landscape anime frame with {카메라 구도} composition; {주요 캐릭터} appears small in the lower foreground facing {거대 용 외형}.
- Background shows {장면 배경}, glowing under {시간대} with {하늘 색감}.
- Frame the dragon as a massive silhouette and detailed creature occupying the upper and mid background, with the swordsman clearly readable in the lower third.
- Add manga/anime panel feeling through dramatic motion lines, atmospheric dust, embers, and one speech bubble, but do not design it as a cover, poster, title card, or key visual.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top / sky: panoramic {하늘 색감}, layered clouds, golden rim light, dragon wings cutting across the sky, no title text.
2) Hero action area: {거대 용 외형} looming forward, head angled toward the swordsman, mouth or chest glowing with restrained magical energy.
3) Foreground character: {주요 캐릭터} in {캐릭터 의상}, holding a sword with {검 효과}, caught at {액션 순간}.
4) Panel details: place a hand-drawn speech bubble at {말풍선 위치} containing {검사 대사}; add small action SFX {작은 효과음} near the sword glow; use {전경 요소} for depth.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Korean speech bubble text in clean hand-lettered anime style, bold but natural; SFX uses angular manga lettering with slight glow.
- Color palette: molten gold #F6B44B, sunset orange #D86A2A, deep violet shadow #2B1E3D, storm blue #36486B, sword cyan accent #77E8FF.
- Background and characters should feel like a finished animation scene panel: painterly digital anime rendering, visible brush texture, crisp character line art, cinematic depth.
- Speech bubble is integrated into the scene like a manga/anime cut, with off-white fill, thin black outline, small tail pointing to the swordsman.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: ultra-wide 24mm cinematic landscape, low angle from behind the swordsman, strong scale exaggeration.
- Lighting: golden hour backlight from upper-left, dragon rim light, sword glow as secondary cyan light on the character silhouette.
- Color grade: filmic anime grade, high contrast, warm highlights, cool shadows, subtle atmospheric haze and dust particles.

[6. MOOD]
Epic isekai adventure anime scene, tense and heroic, like a single dramatic frame before battle.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: {검사 대사}
- Korean text accuracy: {작은 효과음}
- This must look like an in-story anime/manga scene panel, not a cover, not a poster, not promotional key art.
- Keep the swordsman small but readable; sword held with anatomically correct hands and correct perspective.
- Dragon anatomy must feel powerful and coherent: head, horns, wings, claws, and tail arranged believably in depth.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Real brand logos (Apple, Samsung, Naver, Kakao, etc)
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity / unauthorized likeness mixing

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a cinematic digital cel anime concert still frame.
The image must feel like a living scene/panel from an idol music anime, not a cover, poster, or key visual.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Wide 16:9-feeling horizontal stage composition within 1536x1024 canvas, low audience-eye viewpoint looking up toward the stage.
- Place {메인 아이돌 수} original idol characters across the mid-ground stage, with {센터 캐릭터 포즈} as the strongest focal action.
- Foreground bottom 25% filled with silhouetted audience heads, raised arms, and dense {펜라이트 색상} glow sticks creating depth.
- Background: large LED stage wall showing {무대 LED 문구} and abstract heart/star equalizer graphics, not a title-card poster layout.
- Add scene-panel energy through motion lines, hair movement, skirt ribbons, mic cable arcs, sparkle particles, and two small in-scene speech bubbles: {응원 말풍선 1}, {응원 말풍선 2}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top / lighting rig — overhead truss, spotlight heads, volumetric beams in {메인 조명 색상} and {보조 조명 색상}, lens bloom crossing diagonally.
2) Hero area — {센터 아이돌 설명} at center-front, singing into {마이크 종류}, one hand reaching toward the crowd; supporting idols perform synchronized choreography behind her.
3) Mid section — detailed idol outfits with {의상 스타일}, layered frills, metallic trims, hair accessories, individual color accents, expressive anime faces, open-mouth singing.
4) Bottom / audience action — silhouettes, waving arms, glowing penlights, fan emotion, speech bubbles positioned organically inside the scene without looking like advertising copy.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Digital cel anime style with clean ink lines, glossy eyes, soft gradient hair highlights, crisp costume folds, and high-energy concert compositing.
- Typography for LED text: bold Korean sans, clean stage-screen rendering, white/cyan glow, perfectly legible.
- Color palette: dominant hot pink #FF4FA3, electric blue #33A8FF, violet shadow #4934A6, warm skin highlights, deep navy stage blacks.
- Use dynamic panel-like framing: slight Dutch angle, foreground silhouettes cropped at edges, characters partially overlapping light beams for depth.
- Speech bubbles: small rounded white bubbles with thin dark outline, integrated as audience shouts, not promotional captions.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Lighting: intense concert spotlights from upper-left and upper-right, volumetric haze, rim lights on hair and shoulders, backlit glitter particles.
- Color grade: saturated pink-blue idol stage grade, bright highlights, deep contrast, vibrant digital cel finish.

Explosive, emotional, sparkling idol-anime live performance moment frozen mid-song.

[7. CRITICAL]

- Keep the result as an in-universe anime scene still/panel, not a cover, poster, album jacket, thumbnail, or character sheet.
- Characters must be original fictional idols with no resemblance to existing anime IP characters.
- Singing mouths, eyes, hands, microphones, fingers, and choreography poses must be anatomically consistent; hands should have 5 fingers where visible.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

[1. PURPOSE]
Generate a single wide fantasy adventure anime scene still, like an actual episode frame or manga panel.
Show four original RPG party members reacting at a dungeon entrance with dialogue, action, torchlight, and cinematic tension.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Use a wide cinematic panel composition, 16:9-safe inside the 1536x1024 canvas, not a cover, not a poster, not a character lineup sheet.
- Place {파티 구성} in a staggered diagonal group at the threshold of {장면 배경}; characters overlap naturally as if captured mid-action.
- Foreground: {전사 캐릭터} steps forward with {전사 무기}; {도적 캐릭터} crouches near a suspicious floor tile.
- Midground: {마법사 캐릭터} raises {마법사 무기}; {성직자 캐릭터} guards the rear with a lantern or holy charm.
- Background: a massive dungeon gate with {던전 문양}, cracked stone, vines, mist, and deep blue-black interior darkness.
- Add active speech balloons using {말풍선 스타일}, plus an integrated sound effect {효과음} near the trap mechanism.
- Camera uses {카메라 구도}; keep strong depth, foreground silhouettes, and diagonal movement toward the dungeon.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top / panel atmosphere — no title text; only cave ceiling, drifting dust, torch smoke, and faint magical particles.
2) Hero area — four original adventurers performing {주요 액션}; costumes show {의상 디테일}, weapons clearly readable, facial expressions lively.
3) Mid section — stone doorway, glowing runes, broken steps, trap tile, and warm torchlight from {횃불 위치} cutting across the characters.
4) Bottom / panel details — cracked floor, scattered coins, old rope, boot marks, and speech balloons: {전사 말풍선}, {도적 말풍선}, {마법사 말풍선}; keep them inside safe margins.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: clean Korean comic lettering, hand-drawn anime balloon text, thick enough to read at thumbnail size.
- Visual finish: digital cel animation with crisp line art, expressive faces, painted matte background, layered fog, and subtle rim light.
- Color palette: {색상 팔레트}; warm orange torchlight versus cool teal dungeon shadows.
- Linework: {셀 라인 강도}; visible ink contours on characters, softer painterly edges in the background.
- Frame style: {프레임 스타일}; the image must feel like a captured scene panel, not promotional key art.
- Background detail: {배경 디테일}, but keep character silhouettes clear and readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: virtual anime camera, 35mm wide lens feel, low three-quarter angle, moderate perspective exaggeration.
- Lighting: practical torchlight from {횃불 위치}, secondary blue magical glow from the mage staff, faint backlight from dungeon mist.
- Color grade: cinematic fantasy anime grade, high contrast, warm highlights, cool shadows, slightly saturated cel colors.
- Rendering: 2D digital cel characters composited over matte-painted dungeon environment with hand-painted texture.

[6. MOOD]
Energetic lighthearted isekai-fantasy adventure with real danger, comedy timing, and episode-still immediacy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render these strings exactly from the placeholders: {전사 말풍선}, {도적 말풍선}, {마법사 말풍선}, {효과음}.
- Speech balloons must be attached to the correct speaking characters and must not cover faces, hands, weapons, or key action.
- Four characters only; all are original fantasy adventurers, no celebrity likeness, no existing anime character resemblance.
- Hands anatomically correct, visible fingers where shown, weapons not fused with bodies, eyes aligned, readable facial expressions.
- Keep it as one living anime panel/scene with action and dialogue; do not add poster title, logo, credits, release date, or cover layout.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a cinematic cyberpunk anime still frame, like a captured scene from an ongoing episode.
Emphasize manga/anime panel energy: character action, speech bubble, rain, neon reflections, and narrative tension.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {프레임 구도}; place {후드 캐릭터} as the main moving figure, not a centered poster hero.
- Background treatment: {장면 배경} with dense {배경 디테일}, layered signs, cables, wet asphalt, and atmospheric depth.
- Framing: use {카메라 앵글} and {렌즈 느낌}; crop like an in-story animation scene with partial foreground objects.
- Motion: show {캐릭터 액션}, {액션 효과}, rain streaks, and puddle reflections to make the still feel alive.
- Text elements: integrate {말풍선 위치} with {말풍선 문구}; place {간판 문구 1}, {간판 문구 2}, {간판 문구 3} on believable street signage.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top / city layer — high neon signs, overhead cables, monorail shadows, and Korean/Japanese-inspired urban density; include {간판 문구 1} and {간판 문구 2} as visible but natural background signs.
2) Hero area — {후드 캐릭터} in {의상 디테일}, face partly shadowed with {표정}, performing {캐릭터 액션}; keep the body angled diagonally for panel-like momentum.
3) Mid section — wet street depth with {보조 인물}, vending-machine glow, police-drone silhouettes, steam vents, and {액션 효과} cutting through rain.
4) Bottom / foreground — close puddle reflections, tire spray, broken crosswalk lines, {간판 문구 3} reflected in water, and the speech bubble containing {말풍선 문구}; no cover title block or promotional layout.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Korean signage in clean neon sans, speech bubble text in bold readable Korean comic lettering; use {폰트 스타일}.
- Palette: {네온 팔레트} against deep blue-black shadows, wet asphalt gray, and small warm orange highlights.
- Linework: {선화 스타일}; sharp digital cel outlines, selective hatching, speed lines, and hand-drawn panel imperfection.
- Coloring: {채색 방식}; cinematic matte background, cel-shaded character, neon bloom on edges, controlled film grain.
- Borders / panel feel: subtle black letterbox micro-crop and slight animation-frame grain, but no poster masthead.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: {렌즈 느낌}, {카메라 앵글}, horizontal 16:9 animation frame adapted to 1536x1024.
- Lighting: {조명 방향}; violet and cyan neon rim light, reflections from below, soft rain diffusion.
- Weather: {비 강도} with layered raindrops, mist, road splash, and {반사 디테일}.

[1. PURPOSE]

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top area — place jagged overhead stage beams and a small rectangular narration caption with {내레이션 캡션}; smoke curls across the top, no poster-style title block.
2) Hero area — {보컬 캐릭터} leans toward the crowd gripping a microphone, mouth wide open, one arm raised; add a sharp speech bubble containing {보컬 말풍선}.
3) Mid section — {기타리스트 캐릭터} performs a dramatic solo with foreshortened guitar neck cutting across the panel; add bold SFX {기타 효과음}; show {드러머 캐릭터} hitting cymbals behind with {드럼 효과음}.
4) Bottom / crowd — silhouettes and hands surge upward from {관객 분위기}; add crowd shout text {관객 함성} in layered handwritten lettering, with speed lines and halftone bursts connecting the crowd to the stage.

- Color palette specifics: {무대 조명 색상} over deep ink black #08080B, electric white highlights, cyan/magenta rim light, grayscale manga screentone in selected shadow panels.
- Border / shadow / corner details: one full-bleed panel with irregular inked edges, high-contrast black line art, halftone dots, speed lines, sweat highlights, and impact bursts.
- Character rendering: expressive anime/manga faces, exaggerated mouth shape, hair and clothing pulled by motion, detailed hands on microphone and guitar fretboard.

2) Panel 2 / Coffee close-up — Medium close-up of hands around cups on a wooden table. Show {음료와 소품}. Add small speech bubble {대사 2}; steam curls should guide the reader’s eye.
3) Panel 3 / Expression beat — Tight panel on {친구 A 표정 장면}; background simplified with watercolor wash. Add speech bubble {대사 3}.

5) Panel 5 / Wide cafe shot — Bottom wide cinematic panel of the whole cafe corner, both friends small but visible at the table. Include warm ambience, plants, counter silhouettes, window glow, and caption box {캡션 2}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: clean Korean comic lettering, hand-drawn rounded sans style; captions in small neat handwritten Korean.
- Speech bubbles: white fill, thin warm gray outline, soft rounded shapes, tails accurately directed to speakers.
- Color palette: {수채화 팔레트}, paper base #F7F1E6, muted brown ink lines #4A3A31, cream highlights, low saturation.
- Panel borders: {패널 테두리}; gutters remain clean and intentional.
- Character design: gentle Korean webtoon / slice-of-life animation style, expressive eyes, simple but believable anatomy, repeated outfits.
- Avoid poster-like central title composition; each panel must contain a living scene, action, and readable sequential flow.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: comic storyboard language with 35mm establishing views, 50mm conversational shots, 85mm emotional close-up, macro-like coffee detail.
- Lighting: {조명}, soft natural light from upper-left window, mild ambient bounce from cafe interior.
- Color grade: warm watercolor digital painting, soft paper texture, transparent layered washes, delicate ink contour lines.

[6. MOOD]
Quiet Korean cafe daily life, tender, intimate, slow-paced, emotionally warm.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render these strings exactly as image text: {캡션 1}, {대사 1}, {대사 2}, {대사 3}, {대사 4}, {대사 5}, {캡션 2}.

- Speech bubble tails must point to the correct speaker; Korean text must be legible and not distorted.

[1. PURPOSE]

Emphasize living panel storytelling: character acting, action timing, magic effects, speech bubbles, and Korean comic text.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Page layout: {패널 구성} with clean black gutters and dynamic diagonal energy flow from top-left to bottom-right.
- Main hero panel: {마법사 캐릭터} placed slightly off-center, full-body to three-quarter view, casting {마법 속성} toward the page direction.
- Small reaction panel: {동료 캐릭터} shown in a tight bust shot, shocked expression, hands raised or gripping gear, speech bubble visible.
- Small impact panel: {적 캐릭터} hit by the spell, silhouette and armor fragments inside a bright magical explosion.
- Background treatment: {모험 배경} continues visually across panels but each panel has a distinct camera angle.
- Framing: thick outer page margin, crisp comic gutters, no cover title layout, no poster-like single hero composition.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top / large panel — Occupy about {큰 패널 비율} of the page height. Show {마법사 캐릭터} in a low-angle action pose, cloak and hair pushed by wind, staff or hand pointed forward. Put a jagged spell speech bubble near the caster containing {주문 문구}. Add swirling {마법 색상} runes, sparks, and motion streaks.
2) Middle small panel — Place on {작은 패널 위치 1}. Show {동료 캐릭터} reacting to the spell with wide eyes and dramatic face shading. Add a rounded speech bubble containing {동료 대사}. Background speed lines should point toward the large panel action.
3) Bottom small panel — Place on {작은 패널 위치 2}. Show {적 캐릭터} exploding backward from magical impact, with debris, smoke, starburst flash, and comic impact lettering {폭발 효과음} integrated into the burst.
4) Page rhythm / gutters — Use {거터 스타일}; include subtle panel overlap by magic effects crossing near panel borders while keeping the reading order clear.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Korean comic lettering, hand-drawn bold sans for speech bubbles, heavy angular sound effect letters for impact text.
- Speech bubbles: white fill, black ink outline, tail accurately pointing to the speaking character; spell bubble can be jagged and glowing.
- Line art: clean anime-comic ink lines, varied line weight, visible speed lines, impact marks, cloth folds, expressive eyes.
- Color palette: {마법 색상} as the dominant glow, contrasted with {배경 색감}; shadows in deep violet and navy, highlights in pale cyan-white.
- Panel borders: thick black outer frame, medium black inner gutters, slightly irregular hand-drawn panel edges for action energy.
- Character detail: maintain distinct silhouettes, readable costumes, heroic fantasy gear, dynamic fabric and hair motion.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: comic page simulation with cinematic 24mm low-angle hero shot, 70mm reaction close-up, 35mm impact action shot.
- Lighting: magical key light from the spell core, rim light along faces and armor, high-contrast cel shading with painterly digital gradients.
- Color grade: saturated digital color, anime adventure palette, glowing particles, luminous bloom restrained enough to keep line art readable.

[6. MOOD]
Energetic fantasy battle manga page, dramatic, adventurous, and mid-action.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings MUST appear verbatim in the image: {주문 문구}, {동료 대사}, {폭발 효과음}.
- Must read as an interior sequential comic page with 3 panels, not a cover, poster, splash art, or single illustration.
- Reading order must be clear: large magic-casting panel first, companion reaction second, enemy explosion third.
- Hands anatomically correct, staff grip believable, faces expressive, speech bubble tails point to correct speakers.

- Celebrity / unauthorized likeness mixing

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a single high-energy Korean sports manga panel, not a cover or poster.
Focus on one explosive basketball jump shot moment with live panel storytelling.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {주인공 설정} dominates the center-right foreground, captured mid-air in a low-angle jump shot.
- Camera viewpoint: extreme low angle from below the defender line, making the shooter look towering and dynamic.
- Background treatment: simplified indoor court with {코트 배경} suggested through speed lines, hoop perspective, and blurred bleachers.
- Framing: square manga panel crop, ball near upper-left trajectory, shooter body diagonal from lower-right to upper-left.
- Speech balloon: place {말풍선 문구} in a jagged shout balloon near the shooter’s face, integrated inside the panel.
- Sound effect: place {효과음 문구} along the ball trail in hand-drawn Korean lettering.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top / ball trajectory — basketball leaving the fingertips, arcing toward a slightly foreshortened hoop, surrounded by radial speed lines and {효과음 문구}.
2) Hero area — {주인공 설정} in {유니폼 설정}, fully airborne with knees tucked, shooting arm extended, intense eyes, open mouth shouting {말풍선 문구}.
3) Mid section — trailing motion smear, sweat droplets, jersey folds, strong black ink shadows, screen-tone muscles and hair texture.
4) Bottom / panel energy — low-angle court floor perspective, speed-line burst from the shoes, faint defender silhouette and crowd tone blocks to amplify height and tension.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Korean hand-lettered manga style; speech balloon text bold, slightly uneven, black ink on white balloon.
- Linework: {라인 스타일}, heavy outlines on character, sharp hatching on shadows, expressive contour strokes.
- Palette: pure black ink, white paper, grayscale screen-tone dots, no full color; use {스크린톤 밀도} for shadows and background energy.
- Panel treatment: one square comic panel only, cinematic action scene, thick black outer panel border, no poster headline layout.
- Effects: {속도선 강도}, sweat droplets, impact hatching, radial burst from ball and shooting hand.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: manga-style extreme low-angle equivalent to 18mm wide lens, dramatic foreshortening of hand, ball, and legs.
- Lighting: high-contrast gymnasium overhead light, hard black shadows under jaw, arm, jersey folds, and shoes.
- Color grade: monochrome ink illustration with authentic screentone texture and slight paper grain.

[6. MOOD]
Explosive shonen sports manga tension, last-second shot energy, sweaty and urgent.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: {말풍선 문구} must appear verbatim in the speech balloon.
- Korean text accuracy: {효과음 문구} must appear verbatim along the ball trail.
- This must read as a real manga panel scene, not a cover, poster, thumbnail, or character sheet.
- Basketball anatomy: shooting hand has 5 fingers, wrist follow-through is clear, airborne pose is physically believable.
- Ball, hoop, rim, and shooting direction must align so the shot trajectory is readable.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: title in {폰트 제목}, body in {폰트 본문}; clean Korean sans-serif with clear numerals.
- Palette: warm off-white base, ocean teal accents, tangerine highlights, deep navy text.
- Use rounded rectangles, thin divider lines, soft drop shadows, and subtle paper grain.
- Keep spacing airy; align amounts in a neat right column; use bold weight for all won amounts.
- Decorative elements: {장식 요소} should stay minimal and support the travel mood.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat editorial graphic design, no physical camera perspective, crisp vector-like rendering.
- Lighting: soft ambient studio lighting impression with gentle top-left highlight.
- Color grade: clean travel magazine palette, warm whites, teal sea tones, soft orange accents.

[6. MOOD]
Practical, calm, modern digital nomad travel planning.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render these strings verbatim through the placeholders: {카드 제목}, {카드 설명}, {기준 날짜}, {지역 라벨}, {지역 값}, {기간 라벨}, {기간 값}, {총예산 라벨}, {총예산 금액}, {숙소 항목명}, {숙소 금액}, {숙소 설명}, {렌터카 항목명}, {렌터카 금액}, {렌터카 설명}, {카페 작업비 항목명}, {카페 작업비 금액}, {카페 작업비 설명}, {식비 항목명}, {식비 금액}, {식비 설명}, {예비비 항목명}, {예비비 금액}, {예비비 설명}, {팁 제목}, {팁 문장 1}, {팁 문장 2}, {하단 문구}.
- All numbers, commas, won symbols, and multiplication symbols must be legible and unchanged.
- Maintain a strict infographic hierarchy: title, summary chips, budget rows, tip box, footer.

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a vertical indie publishing book fair poster for a small alley bookstore festival.
Focus on booth guidance, handmade publishing culture, and warm neighborhood energy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Centered editorial poster layout with generous margins and a tactile printed-paper feeling.
- Top 28%: bold event title and subtitle, slightly imperfect letterpress alignment.
- Middle 45%: illustrated alley map with tiny bookstore fronts, creator tables, book stacks, arrows, and booth labels.
- Bottom 27%: booth list grid, event info, and simple CTA line.
- Use {메인 배경색} as the paper base, {포인트 색상} and {보조 색상} for riso-style overlays, and {잉크 색상} for all essential text.
- Keep hierarchy clear: {행사명} must be the largest text, {섹션 제목} second largest.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header / top — Place {행사명} centered in a bold Korean serif display style, with {부제} directly underneath in smaller clean sans-serif. Add small hand-drawn book icons around the title using {장식 요소}.
2) Hero area — Draw an isometric-but-flat alley bookstore map: narrow lane, small bookshop facades, folding tables, creator booths, paper banners, and readable labels from {지도 라벨}. Use playful arrows leading viewers through the booths.
3) Mid section — Place {섹션 제목} above a compact booth directory. Show {참여 부스 목록} as a neat two-column list with booth codes in small rounded tags.
4) Bottom / CTA — Add {날짜와 시간}, {장소}, {안내 문구}, and {문의 문구} in a grounded information block with thin divider lines and small book-stamp motifs.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Korean serif display for the title, modern Korean sans-serif for information, small handwritten-style accents for map labels.
- Color palette: {메인 배경색}, {잉크 색상}, {포인트 색상}, {보조 색상}, plus slightly faded overprint texture.
- Poster finish: risograph-inspired grain, imperfect ink registration, soft paper fibers, thin black divider rules.
- Use rounded booth tags, simple line icons, and hand-drawn arrows; keep all Korean text crisp and legible.
- Layout should feel independent, local, intimate, and curated rather than corporate.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: straight-on flat graphic poster scan, no perspective distortion, 50mm equivalent.
- Lighting: even soft studio scan lighting, visible matte paper texture.
- Color grade: warm ivory paper, muted orange, forest green, deep charcoal ink, subtle vintage fade.

[6. MOOD]
Warm neighborhood zine fair, handmade editorial poster, cozy independent bookstore festival.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the poster must include these exact strings from the arguments: {행사명}, {부제}, {섹션 제목}, {참여 부스 목록}, {날짜와 시간}, {장소}, {안내 문구}, {문의 문구}, {지도 라벨}.
- All booth codes and Korean names must be readable, with no missing strokes or broken Hangul.
- Maintain a clean vertical 2:3 poster composition with title, map, booth list, and event info in that order.
- Do not crop essential text; keep at least 6% safe margin on all sides.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Real brand logos (Apple, Samsung, Naver, Kakao, etc)
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity / unauthorized likeness mixing

[1. PURPOSE]

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical 2:3 card with {레이아웃 방향}; hero produce basket centered, text blocks stacked clearly.
- Background treatment: {배경 색상} with subtle paper grain and soft organic shapes in {강조 색상} and {보조 색상}.
- Maintain generous margins, rounded information panels, clear hierarchy for mobile readability.
- Use {제품 연출} as the main food subject, styled as {사진 스타일}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header / top — Place {상단 라벨} as a small rounded pill, {브랜드명} as a neat small brand line, then large headline {메인 제목}. Add {서브 문구} beneath in medium weight.
2) Hero area — Center a warm flat-lay/three-quarter basket scene using {제품 연출}; add small decorative {장식 요소} around the basket without hiding text.
3) Mid section — Add two rounded cards: left card titled {구성 제목} with {채소 항목}, {과일 항목}, {쌀 항목}; right card titled {혜택 제목} with {혜택 1}, {혜택 2}, {혜택 3}. Include {참고 지역} and {배송 문구} as supporting badges.
4) Bottom / CTA — Show {가격 문구} prominently, {하단 안내} below it, a strong button with {CTA 문구}, then {문의 문구} and {날짜 문구} in small footer text.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: headline in {제목 글꼴}, body and labels in {본문 글꼴}; Korean text must be crisp, balanced, and correctly spaced.
- Palette: use {배경 색상} as base, {강조 색상} for CTA and headers, {보조 색상} for highlights; add natural produce colors only.
- Cards: rounded 28px corners, soft shadow, thin cream-white borders, tactile paper texture.
- Illustration/photo mix: keep produce abundant, fresh, and appetizing while preserving clean ad readability.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product photography look, 50mm lens, slight top-down 35-degree angle for the basket.
- Lighting: large softbox from upper-left, gentle fill, natural morning-market warmth.
- Color grade: warm organic greens, soft yellows, creamy whites, low contrast shadows, fresh saturation.

[6. MOOD]
Warm, trustworthy local market advertising with a premium handmade touch.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render verbatim {브랜드명}, {상단 라벨}, {메인 제목}, {서브 문구}, {배송 문구}, {구성 제목}, {채소 항목}, {과일 항목}, {쌀 항목}, {혜택 제목}, {혜택 1}, {혜택 2}, {혜택 3}, {가격 문구}, {하단 안내}, {CTA 문구}, {문의 문구}, {날짜 문구}, {참고 지역}.
- Layout invariants: all text must stay inside the card safe area; CTA must be clearly button-like; produce must not cover Korean text.
- Food anatomy: vegetables, fruit, and rice packaging should look natural, fresh, and recognizable.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Real brand logos (Apple, Samsung, Naver, Kakao, etc)
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a horizontal promotional banner for a Han River picnic rental shop.
Show an inviting picnic set package with clear Korean ad copy and reservation CTA.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]

- Keep generous margins, strong left-to-right reading flow, and enough negative space for Korean text readability.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header / top — Place {브랜드명} at top-left in small premium badge style; place {위치 문구} as a subtle top-right label.
2) Hero area — Arrange {돗자리 색상} mat, {테이블 스타일}, {보드게임 종류}, {조명 스타일}, and {음식 소품} as a polished rental set; include {인물 구성} casually enjoying the setup without blocking products.
3) Mid section — Large bold headline {메인 문구}, supporting line {서브 문구}, and rounded highlight pill {혜택 문구}; use {강조 색상} for emphasis.
4) Bottom / CTA — Clean info bar with {구성품 문구}, {가격 문구}, {날짜 문구}, {연락 문구}; right end has a prominent rounded button reading {예약 버튼 문구}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: {폰트 스타일}; headline in extra-bold Korean sans, supporting text in medium-weight Korean sans, numerals in clean geometric sans.
- Color palette: warm ivory background panels, deep navy text, {강조 색상} CTA, {보조 색상} highlight chips, natural green grass and sunset river tones.
- Use rounded cards, soft drop shadows, thin cream borders, and subtle sticker-like labels for rental items.

- Lighting: golden hour sunlight from upper-left with soft fill, warm fairy-light glow visible but natural.
- Color grade: {사진 분위기}, warm pastel highlights, clean contrast, commercial social media banner finish.

Cozy Seoul riverside lifestyle ad with cheerful weekend picnic energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render these text fields exactly and legibly: {브랜드명}, {메인 문구}, {서브 문구}, {혜택 문구}, {구성품 문구}, {가격 문구}, {예약 버튼 문구}, {위치 문구}, {날짜 문구}, {연락 문구}.

- Human anatomy must be natural; hands and fingers correct if visible.
- Text must not be cropped; CTA button must remain fully inside the canvas.

- Celebrity or unauthorized likeness mixing

4) Bottom / CTA — add a full-width CTA button with {CTA 문구}, then small helper text {참여 안내 문구} and deadline line {마감 안내 문구}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: {본문 글꼴} for all Korean text; title in extra-bold, options in medium weight, helper text in regular.
- Color palette: {카드 배경색}, {배경색}, {메인 강조색}, {보조 강조색}, {본문 글자색}; maintain high contrast and soft corporate friendliness.

- Lighting: soft ambient studio light with gentle top-left highlight and subtle drop shadows.
- Color grade: warm neutral office palette, pastel accents, crisp vector edges, high readability.

Friendly HR announcement, playful office culture, clean internal communication.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render the supplied values exactly for {상단 라벨}, {작성 날짜}, {카드 제목}, {카드 부제}, {투표 박스 문구}, {카테고리 1 제목}, {카테고리 1 옵션 1}, {카테고리 1 옵션 2}, {카테고리 1 옵션 3}, {카테고리 2 제목}, {카테고리 2 옵션 1}, {카테고리 2 옵션 2}, {카테고리 2 옵션 3}, {카테고리 3 제목}, {카테고리 3 옵션 1}, {카테고리 3 옵션 2}, {카테고리 3 옵션 3}, {CTA 문구}, {참여 안내 문구}, {마감 안내 문구}.

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a premium horizontal advertising banner for a Korean traditional alcohol subscription box.
Show makgeolli, yakju, distilled soju, and seasonal snacks as an elegant curated service.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Use a 3:2 horizontal hero banner composition with product still life on the right 55% and copy block on the left 45%.
- Place {서비스명} as a refined top-left brand line, {메인 카피} as the largest headline, {서브 카피} below it, then {혜택 문구} and {CTA 문구} as the conversion area.
- Hero still life includes {대표 주종}, {구독 박스 구성}, and {계절 안주} arranged on {소품 표면} with generous negative space.
- Background uses {배경 스타일} with a soft premium gradient from {배경 색상} to warm ivory, plus subtle Korean paper texture.
- Add {장식 요소} lightly around the hero area without blocking text.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header / top — small premium label with {서비스명} at upper-left, thin divider line in {포인트 색상}, optional micro text {상단 보조 문구}.
2) Hero area — right side still life: elegant subscription box opened slightly, bottles and cups for {대표 주종}, small plates of {계절 안주}, premium wrapping, tasteful shadows.
3) Mid section — left center headline {메인 카피} in large Korean serif, supporting line {서브 카피}, and three compact feature chips: {특징 1}, {특징 2}, {특징 3}.
4) Bottom / CTA — place {혜택 문구} above a rounded button containing {CTA 문구}; add small date or season badge {시즌 배지} near the product composition.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Korean serif for headline, clean Korean sans-serif for subcopy and CTA; use Noto Serif KR / Pretendard style hierarchy.
- Color palette: {배경 색상}, ivory #F7F0E4, dark ink #2B2118, {포인트 색상}, muted brass #B89255.
- Product box: matte paper, embossed-looking pattern, premium gift packaging, soft rounded corners.
- Button: rounded rectangle, solid {포인트 색상}, ivory text, subtle shadow.
- Keep copy readable with high contrast and 8-12% safe margins from all edges.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Phase One IQ4 studio product photography, 80mm lens, slight top-down angle.
- Lighting: large softbox from upper-left, warm bounce fill from front-right, gentle highlights on glass and ceramic.
- Color grade: warm premium editorial, natural alcohol tones, refined Korean lifestyle magazine finish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean heritage meets modern seasonal home dining.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render these strings verbatim: {서비스명}, {상단 보조 문구}, {메인 카피}, {서브 카피}, {특징 1}, {특징 2}, {특징 3}, {혜택 문구}, {CTA 문구}, {시즌 배지}.
- Maintain correct bottle proportions, upright labels without fake brand logos, natural glass reflections, realistic ceramic cups.
- Food plating must look appetizing and seasonal; avoid confusing alcohol with non-food chemical bottles.
- All Korean typography must be clean, legible, and free of broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Real brand logos (Apple, Samsung, Naver, Kakao, etc)
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity / unauthorized likeness mixing

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]

4) Bottom / CTA — Add {하단 안내 문구} centered in a slim rounded bar with tiny {아이콘 스타일} decorations.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: {폰트 스타일}, bold display weight for the title, medium weight for card titles, highly legible body text.
- Color palette: {메인 배경색}, {카드 배경색}, {강조색}, {보조 강조색}, and {본문 색상}; keep a warm Korean lifestyle magazine feel.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Lighting: bright softbox front light, gentle fill, smooth skin tones, low contrast shadows.
- Color grade: soft cream, peach, and brown tones; airy, friendly, slightly editorial.

[6. MOOD]
Friendly, practical, cute Korean lifestyle guide board for instant photo ideas.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render these strings exactly as provided by the arguments: {보드 제목}, {보드 설명}, {날짜 문구}, {패널 1 제목}, {패널 1 설명}, {패널 2 제목}, {패널 2 설명}, {패널 3 제목}, {패널 3 설명}, {패널 4 제목}, {패널 4 설명}, {패널 5 제목}, {패널 5 설명}, {패널 6 제목}, {패널 6 설명}, {하단 안내 문구}.

Each card contains a large number label, one icon, a mini kiosk screen mockup, and text: {단계 1 라벨} {단계 1 제목} {단계 1 설명}; {단계 2 라벨} {단계 2 제목} {단계 2 설명}; {단계 3 라벨} {단계 3 제목} {단계 3 설명}; {단계 4 라벨} {단계 4 제목} {단계 4 설명}; {단계 5 라벨} {단계 5 제목} {단계 5 설명}.

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a vertical watercolor travel poster of a charming city street.
Show a central landmark tower framed by colorful apartment buildings, cafés, trees, and tiny pedestrians.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Place {중앙 랜드마크} exactly on the center vertical axis, rising from the distant street and extending into the open sky.
- Use {카메라 시점}: a street-level view with a narrow road forming a strong vanishing point toward the tower.
- Flank the scene with {건물 양식}: tall mid-rise buildings on both sides, cropped slightly by the canvas edges for an immersive poster feel.
- Apply {좌측 건물 색상} on the left block and {우측 건물 색상} on the right block, with varied window sizes, balconies, flower boxes, and shopfronts.
- Fill the lower third with {거리 구성}, {상점 유형}, and {사람 밀도}; keep figures small and illustrative.
- Add {나무 배치} around the top corners and street edges, matching {계절}.
- Maintain {포스터 여백}: airy white sky around the tower and full-bleed illustrated edges.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header / top — A bright {하늘 상태} with loose watercolor wash, pale distant buildings, tiny birds, and leafy tree canopies entering from both upper corners.
2) Hero area — {중앙 랜드마크} centered, tall and delicate, with {랜드마크 색상}, lattice details, observation decks, and a clean silhouette against the sky.
3) Mid section — Layered {건물 양식} with façades, balconies, chimneys, antennas, potted plants, and soft background depth; use {간판 처리} on shops without dominant text.
4) Bottom / CTA — No CTA text; create a lively street corner with {상점 유형}, café tables, bicycles, tiny pedestrians, crosswalk hints, and wet-looking pale pavement in {도로 색감}.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Use {일러스트 기법}: hand-painted watercolor with ink line accents, visible paper grain, transparent washes, and uneven pigment blooms.
- Linework: {선 표현}; fine black and brown pen strokes, slightly imperfect architecture, charming sketchbook detail.
- Palette: {팔레트} with warm reds, ochres, teal blue, dark green storefronts, pale gray pavement, and fresh spring greens.
- Typography: avoid main headline typography; signage follows {간판 처리}, using tiny abstract strokes or fictional unreadable marks only.
- Borders / texture: no hard border; keep a premium art-print look with subtle watercolor paper texture across the whole image.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: {렌즈 느낌}, eye-level 35mm street perspective, slight vertical exaggeration for the central tower, deep illustrative focus.
- Lighting: {조명}, soft daylight from upper-left, gentle shadows under balconies and awnings.
- Color grade: bright, optimistic, low-contrast watercolor grade with warm highlights and cool gray city depth.

[6. MOOD]
{전체 분위기}: whimsical travel diary, cozy urban morning, elegant illustrated poster.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: N/A — no Korean strings required in the image.
- Keep {중앙 랜드마크} vertical, centered, and clearly taller than surrounding buildings.
- Maintain plausible street depth: road narrows toward the landmark, buildings align along both sides.
- Tiny pedestrians must have simple but anatomically coherent silhouettes; avoid oversized or distorted faces.
- Windows, balconies, and railings should repeat rhythmically without becoming rigid or photorealistic.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Real brand logos (Apple, Samsung, Naver, Kakao, etc)
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity or unauthorized likeness mixing

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a warm seasonal Korean Parents' Day miniature city diorama.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Isometric 3/4 aerial view of a cute miniature urban plaza, with {중심 건물} placed in the center as the hero object.
- Surround the plaza with mid-rise apartment and shop buildings, leaving clear sightlines to vertical banners on both left and right buildings.
- Fill the foreground and central plaza with {대표 꽃}, planters, flower carts, small family characters, heart props, compact cars, street lamps, and café parasols.
- Main family moment: {주인공 가족 구성} placed slightly below center, exchanging a bouquet.
- Background treatment: soft-focus miniature city blocks with warm sunlight and shallow depth of field.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header / top — city buildings and rooftops with greenery; place {왼쪽 배너 문구} on the left building and {오른쪽 배너 문구} on the right building as large vertical fabric banners.
2) Hero area — central glass-domed {중심 건물} filled with {대표 꽃}; attach a cream signboard with {메인 간판 문구} above the entrance.
3) Mid section — plaza walkway with {주인공 가족 구성}, several cute child-and-parent figures, bouquet exchanges, red flower buckets, and warm street details.
4) Bottom / CTA — foreground flower beds and small signs; place a translucent red heart sculpture with {하트 조형물 문구} on the left and a rounded standing sign with {앞쪽 안내판 문구} near the lower center-right.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: rounded Korean sans-serif, thick and legible, hand-painted sign feeling; use deep red and navy lettering on cream fabric/signboards.
- Color palette: {주요 색상 팔레트}, with red carnation accents, cream stone pavement, warm beige buildings, soft green foliage, pastel cars.
- Render as high-quality 3D toy-diorama illustration with chibi proportions, rounded faces, glossy eyes, soft clay-like skin, and detailed miniature props.
- Materials: transparent glass dome with gold metal ribs, striped red-white awning, fabric banners, lacquered heart sculpture, ceramic flower pots.
- Composition should feel abundant and festive while keeping all Korean text areas clean and readable.

1:1 정사각형 화면에 5장 사진 스크랩북 콜라주를 구성한다. 중앙에는 가장 큰 둥근 사각형 히어로 사진으로 {대표 장면}을 배치하고, 주변에는 {음식 장면}, {음료 장면}, {응원 소품}, {전광판 분위기} 스냅샷을 즉석사진처럼 살짝 회전시켜 놓는다. 상단에는 {메인 제목}과 {오늘 날짜}, 작은 야구공 아이콘과 반짝이 표시를 넣고, 중앙 사진에는 {경기장 이름} 캡션 태그를 붙인다. 하단에는 {응원 문구} 스티커 리본과 {팀 별칭}, {해시태그 문구}가 적힌 미니 스코어카드 메모를 배치한다. 배경은 {배경 스타일}에 종이 질감, 야구장 조명 보케, 대각선 야구공 실밥 포인트를 더한다.

[스타일]
스마트폰 스냅사진 느낌의 사진 콜라주, 야간 경기장 조명과 따뜻한 매점 불빛, LED 응원봉 글로우, 영화적인 보케.
{포인트 색상}, 앰버, 맥주 골드, 치킨 브라운, 딥 네이비, 크림 페이퍼 톤을 사용하고 굵은 흰 사진 테두리와 반투명 와시테이프, 부드러운 그림자를 적용한다.

[텍스트]
"{메인 제목}", "{오늘 날짜}", "{경기장 이름}", "{응원 문구}", "{팀 별칭}", "{해시태그 문구}"

[🚫 중요]
한국어 텍스트 정확히 / 한글 깨짐 X
실제 식음료·소매·전자제품 브랜드 로고 스타벅스·맥도날드·삼성전자·LG 등 X
단 다음은 실제 그대로 OK: KBO 야구팀 삼성·SSG·LG·롯데·두산·KIA·NC·키움·한화·KT / K리그·KBL 등 한국 스포츠팀 / KBS·MBC·SBS·JTBC·tvN·MBN·YTN 같은 한국 방송사 UI·로고·자막
콜라주 사진은 주요 한국어 텍스트와 겹치지 않게 가독성을 유지하고, 치킨·맥주·응원 소품은 사실적이고 먹음직스럽게 표현할 것

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a vertical tourism advertisement for a Korean hanbok rental and palace photo snap package.
Premium travel poster style optimized for SNS ads and local tour promotion.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: hero couple or friends in {한복 스타일} centered slightly lower than midline, walking in front of {궁궐 배경}.
- Background treatment: elegant royal palace architecture with soft depth of field, warm daylight, subtle bokeh, no real brand signage.
- Spacing: generous top area for headline, central hero photography, lower information card and CTA.
- Framing: full-body hanbok silhouettes visible, palace roof lines and stone courtyard create depth.
- Use {메인 컬러}, {보조 컬러}, and {강조 컬러} throughout typography and graphic accents.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header / top — Place {상단 라벨} in a small rounded pill at the top center, then set {메인 헤드라인} in large elegant Korean serif, with {서브 헤드라인} beneath in clean sans-serif.
2) Hero area — Show {모델 구성} wearing {한복 스타일}, naturally posing with rented hanbok accessories in front of {궁궐 배경}; include soft sun flare and premium travel photography mood.
3) Mid section — Add a translucent ivory information card containing {패키지 구성 제목} and three benefit lines: {혜택 1}, {혜택 2}, {혜택 3}; use small line icons inspired by camera, hanbok, and walking route.
4) Bottom / CTA — Place {가격 문구} prominently, then {예약 문구} as a bold button, and {하단 안내 문구} in small text at the very bottom.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: main headline in refined Korean serif similar to Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo; body and CTA in modern Korean sans-serif similar to Pretendard.
- Color palette: {메인 컬러} for deep traditional elegance, {보조 컬러} for warm paper background overlays, {강조 컬러} for CTA and small decorative strokes.
- Graphic details: rounded rectangle cards with 85% opacity, thin gold border lines, subtle drop shadow, traditional cloud motif corner ornaments.
- Text hierarchy: headline largest, price second largest, CTA button high contrast; keep all Korean letters crisp and readable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame DSLR look, 50mm f/1.8 for natural travel portrait depth, slight compression.
- Lighting: warm late-afternoon sunlight from upper-left, soft fill light on faces and hanbok fabric.
- Color grade: warm cinematic Seoul travel tone, cream highlights, muted palace reds and greens, clean skin tones, rich fabric texture.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean palace travel experience, romantic and welcoming.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: The image MUST include these strings verbatim: {상단 라벨}, {메인 헤드라인}, {서브 헤드라인}, {패키지 구성 제목}, {혜택 1}, {혜택 2}, {혜택 3}, {가격 문구}, {예약 문구}, {하단 안내 문구}.
- Full-body hanbok proportions should look natural; sleeves, skirt volume, norigae, and hair accessories should be culturally respectful.
- Human anatomy must be correct: natural hands, correct fingers, realistic facial symmetry.
- Keep palace architecture plausible as Gyeongbokgung-inspired without using official logos or seals.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Real brand logos (Apple, Samsung, Naver, Kakao, etc)
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity / unauthorized likeness mixing

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a square printable reading challenge certificate card for elementary students.
Designed for parents, academies, and study rooms to track vacation reading goals and completed books.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Centered card layout with rounded rectangle paper on a soft illustrated background.
- Top 18%: friendly header with {카드 제목} and small subtitle {카드 부제}.
- Middle 55%: organized reading record area with {목표 권수 라벨}, {읽은 책 라벨}, and multiple blank lines.
- Bottom 27%: progress badge, encouragement message, student info, date, and signature area.
- Use {메인 색상}, {보조 색상}, {강조 색상} as a cheerful elementary-friendly palette.
- Include small book, pencil, star, bookmark, and sunshine illustrations based on {장식 요소}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Header / top — Place {카드 제목} in large rounded Korean sans, centered. Under it place {카드 부제} in smaller neat Korean sans. Add tiny decorative stars and open-book icons around the title.
2) Hero area — Main card body with a cute open book illustration at upper-middle, surrounded by soft clouds and stationery motifs. Keep the illustration supportive, not covering text areas.
3) Mid section — Create a clean tracking table: left column for numbered rows 1–10, wide center column labeled {읽은 책 라벨}, right column for check circles. Add a separate goal box labeled {목표 권수 라벨} with {목표 권수}.
4) Bottom / CTA — Add a rounded badge with {완료 배지 문구}, a warm message {응원 문구}, and three small fields: {이름 라벨}, {날짜 라벨}, {확인 라벨}. Show {발급 날짜} in the date field.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: rounded Korean sans for children, similar to Pretendard Rounded or NanumSquareRound; title extra bold, body medium weight.
- Color palette: {메인 색상} as primary border and header, {보조 색상} as background wash, {강조 색상} for badge and check icons, with cream paper #FFF8E8.
- Card border: thick rounded border, 28px corner radius, subtle drop shadow, dotted inner border for a playful certificate feel.
- Text areas must be crisp, printable, high contrast, with generous spacing for handwriting.
- Keep the design friendly for elementary students, not childish for preschoolers.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat front-facing digital print design, orthographic layout, no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: bright soft studio lighting, paper texture visible, clean vector-meets-watercolor illustration.
- Color grade: warm pastel, clean whites, soft yellow highlights, gentle blue-green accents.

[6. MOOD]
Cheerful educational vacation challenge card with warm academy handout energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must render these strings verbatim: {카드 제목}, {카드 부제}, {목표 권수 라벨}, {목표 권수}, {읽은 책 라벨}, {완료 배지 문구}, {응원 문구}, {이름 라벨}, {날짜 라벨}, {확인 라벨}, {발급 날짜}.
- Maintain square 1:1 printable card composition with all Korean text legible.
- Tracking table must have 10 rows, numbered 1 to 10, with blank writing space and check circles.
- No human hands or faces are required; if characters appear, keep them simple and anatomically correct.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Real brand logos (Apple, Samsung, Naver, Kakao, etc)
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity / unauthorized likeness mixing
